CommunityApplications.Profile: Container templates for the Drumandbytes open-source homelab tools: momentarr (caching, one-at-a-time proxy in front of Byparr/FlareSolverr for Prowlarr), pve-metrics-exporter (Proxmox VE metrics and hardware temperatures for Prometheus and Glance), paddock-api (F1 data API for Glance dashboards), github-actions-runner-exporter (Prometheus metrics for self-hosted GitHub Actions runners) and nordvpn (the official NordVPN client, distroless, as a VPN network for other containers). Each image is built and released from its own GitHub repository. For help, open an issue on that app's repository; template problems go to this repository's issues.
